plan: A very long-range marksman who dominates her lane and lays traps to catch her opponents.
aSurveiller: Her traps (W). They root you and give her an empowered shot: don't step on them, especially near her and in bushes.
contrer: Avoid her traps (W): they are visible, walk around them.
Engage her once her net (E) is used: it's her only way to back off.
Don't stay at half health in range of her R: an ally can step in front to block the bullet.
forces: The longest attack range of all marksmen.
Her traps control the area and protect her.
Finishes off from very far with her R.
faiblesses: Weak if engaged in melee range.
Less effective against very mobile champions.

sorts.P: Every few attacks, a headshot that hurts more.
sorts.Q: Piercing shot in a line after a short wind-up.
sorts.W: Places a trap that roots and reveals.
sorts.E: Net that slows and knocks her backwards.
sorts.R: Very long-range shot on a target; an ally can block it.

momentFort: Very strong in lane from the start, then in the mid game with her critical strike items.
